# Scalar inputs beside an explicit generic array

This independently authored ordinary/variable arity factory retains a boolean,
an optional wide scalar and its original array. The array binds the sole method
formal in an invariant result carrier. An opaque callback chooses an existing
result independently of the boolean, array contents or collection algorithm.

The observer checks scalar and array snapshots, wide values, null/empty/covariant
arrays, callbacks, mutations, array-store failures, exact exceptions and ignored
results. Distinct HashSet/LinkedHashSet/null results remain actual references.
Source and SDK profiles compile all Java8 units and retain every definition,
generic Signature, role and Exceptions attribute. Wrong programs precede
recovery, including packing, copying and an invented set-construction shortcut.
Signature-only controls retain Code and runtime descriptors.
